title: STJ Override File
description: A delta file applying an RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch on top of a base STJ file (wet version, night, alternate layout). Same model as SVJ override files (SVJ_Spec.md §3.4). See STJ_Spec.md §3.3.

base.description: Relative path to the base .stj.json (or another .stj-override.json) this file patches.

variant.description: What kind of variant this is.

patch.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch applied over the resolved base document. The result must validate against stj.schema.json.
